name: agent-and
description: Multi-domain development plugin with 9 specialized subagents: AI vendor research, full-stack coding, security analysis, devops, document creation, trading, installation management, LLM jailbreaking, plus the AND orchestrator.

commands.name: and
commands.description: Route a task through the AND multi-domain agent suite
commands.prompt: The user invoked the AND suite (/and). Act as the AND orchestrator. Classify the task into one domain (coding, security, jailbreak, devops, documents, trading, installation, research), load the matching AND sub-skill from the and-skills directory (skills/<domain>/SKILL.md) and follow its instructions end-to-end. If the task spans multiple domains, split and dispatch in parallel, then merge results. Never answer a domain task from generic knowledge — always follow the sub-skill's doctrine.
